# Gate 2 package - BI-PF-1435
**GCS ObjectStore adapter: streaming/resumable upload + wire buildObjectStore (production-qualification)**

## Plain language
**What/why:** The GCS adapter buffers entire payloads into memory with io.ReadAll, causing memory spikes for large objects; buildObjectStore() lacks GCS backend wiring. -> Chunked resumable upload for objects > 5 MB with on-the-fly checksumming, plus PF_OBJECT_BACKEND=gcs integration in edpsvc.
**Success:** Objects > 5 MB upload via resumable session with bounded memory; PF_OBJECT_BACKEND=gcs initializes GCS; qualification run documented.

## Gate 0 reconciliation + impact
RECONCILIATION - BI-PF-1435
  prior_decisions : ['BI-PF-1305 (EDP-13): ObjectStore abstraction and local adapter.', 'BI-PF-1306 (EDP-14): S3 ObjectStore adapter pattern.', 'BI-PF-1395: Initial GCS ObjectStore adapter using objstorerest stdlib core.']
  existing_path   : ['go/gcsstore/gcsstore.go:74-107: Put method buffering entire body via io.ReadAll before multipart upload.', "go/edpsvc/main.go:101-115: buildObjectStore checking only 's3' and local store."]
  assumptions     : ['Google Cloud Storage standard resumable upload protocol (POST uploadType=resumable then PUT chunks) is supported by Google Cloud Storage and emulators.', '5 MB chunk threshold aligns with Google Cloud Storage minimum resumable chunk size (256 KB multiple, standard 5 MB chunk).']
